caption: The drawing depicts four objects arranged in a loose rectangular composition on a plain, cream-colored background. In the top left corner is a circular stamp with a raised design featuring a bird, plant forms, and a star, all within a double-ringed border; the coloration is in shades of brown, suggesting carved wood. To the right of this stamp is a three-dimensional rendering of a wooden stamp with a rounded handle and broad, flat base, angled so that its base faces the bottom left. In the bottom left corner is another circular stamp, displaying a raised design of a sheaf of wheat flanked by leaves, all enclosed within a ringed border and colored in similar shades of brown. To the right of this stamp is another three-dimensional wooden stamp, also with a rounded handle and broad base, shown at a slightly different angle than the stamp above it. Shadows and shading are used to give the stamps a realistic appearance. The objects are evenly spaced apart, and the artist’s name, W. Wellington Blewett, appears in small letters near the bottom left corner.
title: Butter Mold
